request_payload.title: Delineation of LZTR1 mutation-positive patients with Noonan syndrome and identification of LZTR1 binding to RAF1-PPP1CB complexes.

mentions.sentence: Whole exome sequencing studies recently identified LZTR1, PPP1CB and MRAS as new causative genes in RASopathies.
